text:
Samir: deploy-bot flagged eu-west ingress upgrade 2023.10.7 as failed, 503s from frontend. rolling back?
deploy-bot: AUTO: release/update-ingress v2023.10.7 -> Health check failing on 3/6 hosts, status 503, reason: TLS cert mismatch with values.override 'tls.secretName' (expected 'ingress-eu', found 'ingress-eu-rotated'). See /deploy/logs/1739993337
Dana: ugh, that cert rotation landed in values via the infra-team PR earlier today. Did the chart bump include the new secret name?
Aria: checking helm diff now — looks like chart v1.12.0 changed templates to reference .Values.tls.secretName (was hardcoded). Our rollout used values-prod-eu which didn't include the rotated name.
Samir: so two problems: chart wants new secret name, but values file didn't match. Options: 1) rollback helm to v1.11.3 across eu-west, or 2) hotfix values on prod (patch secretName) and re-run canary. thoughts?
Julian: if we rollback, we avoid user-facing 503s immediately. But we should confirm there are no schema changes that break old chart. Any CRDs?
Aria: no CRD changes. The only template change is ingress tls secret reference and a small annotation change. Rollback is safe.
Dana: can we do a targeted rollback just for the ingress release in eu-west to limit blast radius? helm rollback release-ingress 1 --namespace platform-eu 
Samir: yes, do targeted rollback. But coordinate change window — we're inside the 11:00-13:00 EU release window. I'll run the rollback and monitor. @deploy-bot set a 10m monitor for 200/500 rates.
deploy-bot: ACTION: scheduled helm rollback release-ingress -> v1.11.3 in namespace platform-eu. Monitor: 10m grace, check path /healthz every 15s, alert to #incidents on >1% 5xx.
Samir: running:
```bash
helm rollback release-ingress 1 --namespace platform-eu --kube-context=eu-west
kubectl rollout status deploy/ingress-controller -n platform-eu --context=eu-west --timeout=3m
```
Samir: rollback completed, pod restarts 2->3 and steady. initial requests healthy. streaming metrics show 500s dropped to 0.3%
Dana: nice. Can we also follow up with infra to either: update values-prod-eu to the rotated secret, or make chart accept both keys with a fallback? we should avoid manual hotfixes next time.
Aria: opened PR to values-repo: update tls.secretName -> ingress-eu-rotated, added a config fallback in chart to prefer .Values.tls.secretName or env var. link: https://git.internal/redwood/values/PR-452
Julian: also adding a quick postmortem blurb for release notes: 'Rollback of ingress v1.12.0 in eu-west due to values/secret mismatch during cert rotation; fixed values file and chart fallback; no customer impact after rollback.'
Samir: thanks everyone. Closing the thread after 1h of clean metrics. :thumbsup:
